prompt: In a vibrant anime style illustration, a bustling mountain campsite unfolds under a clear blue sky. On the left side of the frame, a girl with pink pigtails sits on a gray log, her legs crossed comfortably. Next to her, a small brown dog rests its head on her knee, looking up expectantly. A man in a red scarf stands nearby, pointing toward the distant peaks with his right hand. He holds a silver thermos in his left hand, steam rising gently from the spout. In the center foreground, a large orange tent is pitched firmly on the grass, its flap open to reveal a sleeping bag inside. A boy with messy black hair kneels beside the tent entrance, tying the laces of his hiking boots. Behind him, a woman in a yellow raincoat hangs a wet towel on a clothesline stretched between two pine trees. To her right, a golden retriever chases a blue frisbee mid-air, its ears flapping wildly. Further back, an elderly man with white hair sits in a folding chair, reading a thick paperback book. Beside his chair, a green backpack leans against a tree trunk, partially unzipped. A young woman with short blue hair stands next to the backpack, holding a map and studying it intently. She points at a specific trail marked in red ink. Near the fire pit in the lower center, a cat with striped fur curls up on a flat stone, sleeping peacefully. A teenager in a hoodie roasts a marshmallow over the dying embers, holding a long stick with care. Above them, a hawk circles high in the sky, wings spread wide against the clouds. On the right side, a couple shares a blanket; the person with glasses offers a sandwich to their partner with dark curly hair. A wooden picnic table sits empty near the edge of the clearing, covered in scattered pinecones. A lantern hangs from a branch above the table, unlit but ready for nightfall. There is no snow on the ground, indicating a warm season. There is no vehicle visible anywhere in the scene, emphasizing isolation. There is no electronic device such as a phone or laptop present among the campers.
